description: This file defines the SystemService class, which manages system settings including reading, writing, and validation, using singleton pattern and file operations.

classes.name: SystemService
classes.description: A singleton class providing system settings management, including reading from and writing to configuration files, and validating settings.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the SystemService instance and loads system settings from file.

methods.name: _compare_hash
methods.description: Compares input value hash with a stored validation hash.

methods.name: _read_from_file
methods.description: Reads system settings from a file, validates certain fields, and returns a SystemSettings object.

methods.name: write_to_file
methods.description: Serializes and writes system settings to a file.

methods.name: refresh_system_settings
methods.description: Reloads system settings from file and updates internal state.
